lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਥਾਇ ਸਾਖੀ ਮਹਾ ਪੁਰਖ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸਾਝੀ ਸਗਲ ਜਹਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: parathaai saakhee mahaa purakh bolade saajhee sagal jahaanai ||
lines.translation: Great men speak the teachings by relating them to individual situations, but the whole world shares in them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਭਉ ਕਰੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh hoi s bhau kare aapanaa aap pachhaanai ||
lines.translation: One who becomes Gurmukh knows the Fear of God, and realizes his own self.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਤਾ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur parasaadee jeevat marai taa man hee te man maanai ||
lines.translation: If, by Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive, the mind becomes content in itself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਥਹਿ ਗਿਆਨੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau man kee parateet naahee naanak se kiaa kathahi giaanai ||1||
lines.translation: Those who have no faith in their own minds, O Nanak - how can they speak of spiritual wisdom? ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਲਾਇਓ ਅੰਤਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh chit na laaio a(n)t dukh pahutaa aai ||
lines.translation: Those who do not focus their consciousness on the Lord, as Gurmukh, suffer pain and grief in the end.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਬਾਹਰਹੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਂ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)darahu baaharahu a(n)dhiaa(n) sudh na kaaee paai ||
lines.translation: They are blind, inwardly and outwardly, and they do not understand anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਰਕਤੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਖਾਇ ਜੋ ਰਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit tin kee barakatee sabh jagat khaai jo rate har naai ||
lines.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, the whole world is fed for the sake of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਰਹੇ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin gur kai sabad salaahiaa har siu rahe samaai ||
lines.translation: Those who praise the Word of the Guru's Shabad, remain blended with the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਬਰਕਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਧਨੁ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit doojai bhaai barakat na hovaee naa dhan palai paai ||
lines.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, no one is satisfied, and no one finds true wealth through the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਨ ਆਇਓ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paR thake sa(n)tokh na aaio anadin jalat vihaai ||
lines.translation: They have grown weary of reading scriptures, but still, they do not find contentment, and they pass their lives burning, night and day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂਕ ਪੂਕਾਰ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਨਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kook pookaar na chukaee naa sa(n)saa vichahu jaai ||
lines.translation: Their cries and complaints never end, and doubt does not depart from within them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਮੁਹਿ ਕਾਲੈ ਉਠਿ ਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam vihooniaa muhi kaalai uth jaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, they rise up and depart with blackened faces. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣ ਮੇਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਿਲਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਦਸਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sajan mel piaare mil pa(n)th dasaaee ||
lines.translation: O Beloved, lead me to meet my True Friend; meeting with Him, I shall ask Him to show me the Path.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਸੇ ਮਿਤੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo har dase mit tis hau bal jaaee ||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to that Friend, who shows it to me.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਤਿਨ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun saajhee tin siu karee har naam dhiaaee ||
lines.translation: I share His Virtues with Him, and meditate on the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵੀ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har sevee piaaraa nit sev har sukh paaee ||
lines.translation: I serve my Beloved Lord forever; serving the Lord, I have found peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੨॥
lines.transliteration: balihaaree satigur tis jin sojhee paaee ||12||
lines.translation: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has imparted this understanding to me. ||12||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੁਕਈ ਜੇ ਵੇਦ ਪੜੈ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit mail na chukaee je ved paRai jug chaar ||
lines.translation: O Pandit, O religious scholar, your filth shall not be erased, even if you read the Vedas for four ages.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੂਲੁ ਹੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: trai gun maaiaa mool hai vich haumai naam visaar ||
lines.translation: The three qualities are the roots of Maya; in egotism, one forgets the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਭੂਲੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਵਾਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: pa(n)dit bhoole doojai laage maaiaa kai vaapaar ||
lines.translation: The Pandits are deluded, attached to duality, and they deal only in Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਹੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਭੁਖਿਆ ਮੁਏ ਗਵਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar trisanaa bhukh hai moorakh bhukhiaa mue gavaar ||
lines.translation: They are filled with thirst and hunger; the ignorant fools starve to death.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: satigur seviai sukh paaiaa sachai sabad veechaar ||
lines.translation: Serving the True Guru, peace is obtained, contemplating the True Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਹੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਗਈ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)darahu trisanaa bhukh gaee sachai naai piaar ||
lines.translation: Hunger and thirst have departed from within me; I am in love with the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਸਹਜੇ ਰਜੇ ਜਿਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਖਿਆ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naam rate sahaje raje jinaa har rakhiaa ur dhaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those who are imbued with the Naam, who keep the Lord clasped tightly to their hearts, are automatically satisfied. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਗਾ ਬਹੁਤਾ ਆਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh har naam na seviaa dukh lagaa bahutaa aai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukh does not serve the Lord's Name, and so he suffers in horrible pain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੇਰੁ ਹੈ ਸੁਧਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)tar agiaan a(n)dher hai sudh na kaaee paai ||
lines.translation: He is filled with the darkness of ignorance, and he does not understand anything.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਨ ਬੀਜਿਓ ਭੁਖਾ ਕਿ ਅਗੈ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: manahath sahaj na beejio bhukhaa k agai khaai ||
lines.translation: Because of his stubborn mind, he does not plant the seeds of intuitive peace; what will he eat in the world hereafter, to satisfy his hunger?

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naam nidhaan visaariaa doojai lagaa jaai ||
lines.translation: He has forgotten the treasure of the Naam; he is caught in the love of duality.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak guramukh milahi vadiaaeeaa je aape mel milaai ||2||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are honored with glory, when the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: har rasanaa har jas gaavai kharee suhaavanee ||
lines.translation: The tongue which sings the Lord's Praises, is so very beautiful.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo man tan mukh har bolai saa har bhaavanee ||
lines.translation: One who speaks the Lord's Name, with mind, body and mouth, is pleasing to the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਖੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo guramukh chakhai saad saa tripataavanee ||
lines.translation: That Gurmukh tastes the the sublime taste of the Lord, and is satisfied.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun gaavai piaare nit gun gaai gunee samajhaavanee ||
lines.translation: She sings continually the Glorious Praises of her Beloved; singing His Glorious Praises, she is uplifted.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਬੁਲਾਵਣੀ ॥੧੩॥
lines.transliteration: jis hovai aap daiaal saa satiguroo guroo bulaavanee ||13||
lines.translation: She is blessed with the Lord's Mercy, and she chants the Words of the Guru, the True Guru. ||13||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 3 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਸਤੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਹਰਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hasatee sir jiu a(n)kas hai aharan jiu sir dei ||
lines.translation: The elephant offers its head to the reins, and the anvil offers itself to the hammer;

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿ ਕੈ ਊਭੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan aagai raakh kai oobhee sev karei ||
lines.translation: just so, we offer our minds and bodies to our Guru; we stand before Him, and serve Him.
